blocks.text: A pair of wings is never found whole in the wild. It is gathered, forged and joined, piece by piece, and every piece asks you to go somewhere new.

First, the materials: vanilla items, plus the mod's own drops, which only fall for a tool, weapon or rod carrying winged energy. Second, the pieces: harness, core and wings, hammered out at the Forge Bench, often with intermediate parts on the way. Third, the assembly: harness, core, left wing and right wing joined at the Assembly Table.

blocks.caption: From a drop to a pair

blocks.text: The left and right wings are the same piece, made twice. Only the Wings of Yin and Yang need two different ones, a Yin Wing and a Yang Wing.

All pairs of a rarity share the same harness, and each harness is forged from the one below: Iron-Buckled for rare pairs, Gilded for epic, Radiant for legendary, and the Fury Saddle for the two mythics. The core and the wings belong to each pair alone.

A rare pair's pieces come straight from raw materials, in one step. Epic pieces may need one intermediate, legendary pieces two, mythic pieces up to four. Each rarity has its metal: iron, gold, diamond, then netherite.

Every forged piece and every assembly drinks essence from the bench's gauges. Assembling costs nothing for the Common Wings, 100 Cloud for a rare pair, 150 Cloud and 150 Steam for an epic one, 250 Cloud, 250 Steam and 300 Ethereal for a legendary one, and 250 of each of the four essences for a mythic one.
Everything can be farmed again: dragons, withers, raids and trial spawners all come back. No pair depends on a one-time treasure, and no material comes from loot chests or breeding.
With JEI installed, every assembly, every Forge Bench recipe, the compressor and every winged drop, with its chance and condition, is one click away.
